usedFor: Shopify holds paid orders, and Pipefy runs the process after them with “Create Card” and “Create Record”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Paid” in Shopify, then “Create Card” in Pipefy
bestTemplate.why: A paid order starts fulfilment, so the card puts it in the process where the team works.

watchOut: “Order Line Items Are Edited” fires on edits, so one order can create a second card after payment.
